summary: Admissibility of unregistered Agreement to Sell in specific performance suit; validity of Tamil Nadu Amendment Act 2012 inserting Section 17(1)(g) mandating compulsory registration; conflict with proviso to Section 49 Registration Act allowing unregistered documents as evidence in specific performance suits; distinction between pre-amendment (post-Dayal Singh) and post-amendment regimes; whether amendment renders proviso otiose; statutory interpretation of Registration Act amendments.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.7, s.13(2), s.13(1)(d)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Trial Court order restored disallowing unregistered Agreement to Sell as evidence.
